paragraphs.text: This is the third time I am coming to you. At the mouth of two witnesses or three shall every word established.
paragraphs.original: Τρίτον τοῦτο ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς· ἐπὶ στόματος δύο μαρτύρων καὶ τριῶν σταθήσεται πᾶν ῥῆμα.
paragraphs.translit: Triton touto erchomai pros hymas· epi stomatos dyo martyrōn kai triōn stathēsetai pan rhēma.

paragraphs.text: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, to them that have sinned heretofore, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;
paragraphs.original: προείρηκα καὶ προλέγω ὡς παρὼν τὸ δεύτερον καὶ ἀπὼν νῦν, τοῖς προημαρτηκόσιν καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς πᾶσιν, ὅτι ἐὰν ἔλθω εἰς τὸ πάλιν οὐ φείσομαι,
paragraphs.translit: proeirēka kai prolegō hōs parōn to deuteron kai apōn nyn, tois proēmartēkosin kai tois loipois pasin, hoti ean elthō eis to palin ou pheisomai,

paragraphs.text: seeing that ye seek a proof of Christ that speaketh in me; who to you-ward is not weak, but is powerful in you:
paragraphs.original: ἐπεὶ δοκιμὴν ζητεῖτε τοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ λαλοῦντος Χριστοῦ· ὃς εἰς ὑμᾶς οὐκ ἀσθενεῖ ἀλλὰ δυνατεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν,
paragraphs.translit: epei dokimēn zēteite tou en emoi lalountos Christou· hos eis hymas ouk asthenei alla dynatei en hymin,

paragraphs.text: for he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him through the power of God toward you.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γὰρ ἐσταυρώθη ἐξ ἀσθενείας, ἀλλὰ ζῇ ἐκ δυνάμεως θεοῦ. καὶ γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἀσθενοῦμεν ἐν αὐτῷ, ἀλλὰ ζήσομεν σὺν αὐτῷ ἐκ δυνάμεως θεοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: kai gar estaurōthē ex astheneias, alla zē ek dynameōs theou. kai gar hēmeis asthenoumen en autō, alla zēsomen syn autō ek dynameōs theou eis hymas.

paragraphs.text: Try your own selves, whether ye are in the faith; prove your own selves. Or know ye not as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you? unless indeed ye be reprobate.
paragraphs.original: Ἑαυτοὺς πειράζετε εἰ ἐστὲ ἐν τῇ πίστει, ἑαυτοὺς δοκιμάζετε· ἢ οὐκ ἐπιγινώσκετε ἑαυτοὺς ὅτι Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν; εἰ μήτι ἀδόκιμοί ἐστε.
paragraphs.translit: Heautous peirazete ei este en tē pistei, heautous dokimazete· ē ouk epiginōskete heautous hoti Iēsous Christos en hymin; ei mēti adokimoi este.

paragraphs.text: But I hope that ye shall know that we are not reprobate.
paragraphs.original: ἐλπίζω δὲ ὅτι γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἐσμὲν ἀδόκιμοι.
paragraphs.translit: elpizō de hoti gnōsesthe hoti hēmeis ouk esmen adokimoi.

paragraphs.text: Now we pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that ye may do that which is honorable, though we be as reprobate.
paragraphs.original: εὐχόμεθα δὲ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν μὴ ποιῆσαι ὑμᾶς κακὸν μηδέν, οὐχ ἵνα ἡμεῖς δόκιμοι φανῶμεν, ἀλλʼ ἵνα ὑμεῖς τὸ καλὸν ποιῆτε, ἡμεῖς δὲ ὡς ἀδόκιμοι ὦμεν.
paragraphs.translit: euchometha de pros ton theon mē poiēsai hymas kakon mēden, ouch hina hēmeis dokimoi phanōmen, allʼ hina hymeis to kalon poiēte, hēmeis de hōs adokimoi ōmen.

paragraphs.text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ δυνάμεθά τι κατὰ τῆς ἀληθείας, ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ τῆς ἀληθείας.
paragraphs.translit: ou gar dynametha ti kata tēs alētheias, alla hyper tēs alētheias.

paragraphs.text: For we rejoice, when we are weak, and ye are strong: this we also pray for, even your perfecting.
paragraphs.original: χαίρομεν γὰρ ὅταν ἡμεῖς ἀσθενῶμεν, ὑμεῖς δὲ δυνατοὶ ἦτε· τοῦτο καὶ εὐχόμεθα, τὴν ὑμῶν κατάρτισιν.
paragraphs.translit: chairomen gar hotan hēmeis asthenōmen, hymeis de dynatoi ēte· touto kai euchometha, tēn hymōn katartisin.

paragraphs.text: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not when present deal sharply, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for casting down.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτο ταῦτα ἀπὼν γράφω, ἵνα παρὼν μὴ ἀποτόμως χρήσωμαι κατὰ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἣν ὁ κύριος ἔδωκέν μοι, εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto tauta apōn graphō, hina parōn mē apotomōs chrēsōmai kata tēn exousian hēn ho kyrios edōken moi, eis oikodomēn kai ouk eis kathairesin.

paragraphs.text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfected; be comforted; be of the same mind; live in peace: and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
paragraphs.original: Λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί, χαίρετε, καταρτίζεσθε, παρακαλεῖσθε, τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖτε, εἰρηνεύετε, καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Loipon, adelphoi, chairete, katartizesthe, parakaleisthe, to auto phroneite, eirēneuete, kai ho theos tēs agapēs kai eirēnēs estai methʼ hymōn.

paragraphs.text: Salute one another with a holy kiss.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν ἁγίῳ φιλήματι. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἅγιοι πάντες.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe allēlous en hagiō philēmati. aspazontai hymas hoi hagioi pantes.

paragraphs.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.
paragraphs.original: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἡ κοινωνία τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hē charis tou kyriou Iēsou Christou kai hē agapē tou theou kai hē koinōnia tou hagiou pneumatos meta pantōn hymōn.
